item.title: Valet ☆ Style -Loyalty of Valet-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CroixSoft
  • 発売日: 2015-09-25
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ばれっと☆すたいる -Loyalty of valet-
  • 英語名: Valet ☆ Style -Loyalty of Valet-

别名

  • Baresuta

あらすじ

This is the first title by CroixSoft. There are two kinds of students at the prestigious Konoe Gakuen: the children of wealthy families (masters) and those who study hard to become the best butlers (valets). Their school life is one full of grace and dignity. Kazuma, an extremely poor guy who constantly works part-time jobs, was thrust into this different lifestyle after it was discovered that he was actually part of a noble family. He even had his own personal butler. Surrounded by valets and ojou-samas, what kind of encounters lie ahead for him?
